step1_analysis.description: A single PMOS transistor, likely functioning as a unit current source or switch in a current-steering DAC for a burst-mode laser transmitter.

paper_reference.title: A High-Resolution Burst-Mode Laser Transmitter With Fast and Accurate Level Monitoring for 1.25 Gb/s Upstream GPONs

I_out.description: Drain current at typical bias (Vsg=0.9V, Vsd=0.9V)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law model for SKY130 PMOS parameters. Represents a unit current cell for the DAC.

Vth.description: Threshold voltage of the PMOS transistor

sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the expected drain current and overdrive voltage.
Estimated using channel length modulation parameter lambda=0.1/V.

Settling_Time.description: Time required for the output current to settle after a gate voltage step

sky130_expected.calculation: Intrinsic transistor delay is very small, dominated by load capacitance. Without load, expected < 100ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Single transistor intrinsic switching time is much faster than the full DAC settling time reported in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: DC sweeps and Transient analysis to measure threshold voltage, transconductance, output current, output resistance, and switching delay of the PMOS current source.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS Current Source Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
XM1 N1 I_IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_I_IN I_IN 0 DC 0.9 PULSE(1.8 0.9 1n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
V_N1 N1 0 DC 0.9

.control
  * Transient Analysis for Switching Delay
  tran 10p 20n
  let id_tran = abs(i(V_N1))
  meas tran t_delay trig v(I_IN) val=1.35 fall=1 targ id_tran val=50u rise=1
  print t_delay

  * Sweep V_I_IN to find Vth and gm
  dc V_I_IN 1.8 0 -0.01
  let id_sweep = abs(i(V_N1))
  meas dc vth_v_in find v(I_IN) when id_sweep=1u
  let vth_calc = 1.8 - vth_v_in
  
  meas dc id_900 find id_sweep at=0.90
  meas dc id_890 find id_sweep at=0.89
  let gm_calc = (id_890 - id_900)/0.01
  
  print vth_calc gm_calc id_900

  * Sweep V_N1 to find Rout
  dc V_N1 0 1.8 0.01
  let id_rout = abs(i(V_N1))
  meas dc id_n1_900 find id_rout at=0.9
  meas dc id_n1_800 find id_rout at=0.8
  let rout_calc = 0.1 / (id_n1_800 - id_n1_900)
  
  print rout_calc
  
  quit
.endc
